### Tidepool
Tidepool is a small open-source library for data quality checks that I started in 2022.
I maintain it together with my friend Sam Okafor.
## Education
MSc in Data Science, Westbridge University, 2018–2019.
BSc in Computer Science, Calder College, 2014–2018.
